item.title: Four Weekends of DIY: A Water Softener and Kitchen RO
item.description: My 2022 DIY water project: an A.O. Smith softener, a Waterdrop G3P800 under the kitchen sink, and the numbers after four weekends of work.

item.title: Cycling Around Taiwan, 2014–2015
item.description: At the end of 2014 I flew from San Francisco for a nine-day Giant tour around Taiwan, from December 27 to January 4. My Specialized cracked on the morning of Day 1, I finished the island on the tour bike, and then spent a couple of days riding around Taipei on my own.

item.title: My Cycling Years, 2012 to 2014
item.description: A look back at the years I went from a road-bike test ride to century rides, two Levi’s GranFondos, a windy coast ride in Maui, the Rapha Festive 500, and Foxy’s Fall Century.

item.title: My First Century Ride - Mount Hamilton Loop
item.description: A 101.5-mile loop over Mount Hamilton — my first century ride.
